_comment: F47#4 (PROGRESSION: repeated rest cannot mint stock, XP or essence). A rest always heals and restores; it passes to a new morning only when the live hour is in the night window. The window wraps midnight: start_hour 20 to end_hour 4 means 20:00 up to 04:00. Solo rest and the co-op sleep vote read the same window (the host's hour decides a vote).
day_rest_line: You rest a while. Morning only comes after nightfall.
